newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ballard Medical started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ballard Medical started.

text.p: Southwest Securities said on Monday it initiated coverage of Ballard Medical Products Inc with a neutral rating, as managed care pressures would continue to limit the pricing power of medical device makers.
-- Analyst Vincent Colicchio said in a research note his 1997 earnings estimate was $1.05 per share and his 1998 earnings estimate was $1.25 per share.
-- Colicchio said new product introductions and product acquisitions were critical for earnings growth, but device introductions were risky because of costs, regulations and changes in technology.
-- "The company may be unable to acquire attractive companies and product lines at economical valuations," he said. Ballard closed unchanged at 19-3/4.
